title: 第15章 黄錚第16章 法术
lines: 清晨，王扶用过早膳，就下到药田里，看看有没有新的杂草需要清理。
一个月来，他已经把自己负责的十方药田內的杂草反覆清理了乾净，现在每天只需要巡查一遍看看有没有新冒头的杂草，至於清理出来的杂草嘛，都用小鼎吞噬精华淬链成了灵液。
“若是把这些灵药淬链成灵液，那功效肯定比清灵潭的潭水还要强……”
王扶看著药田里长势不错的灵药舔了舔嘴唇，不过他也就想想，这里的灵药每一株都有规格数量，少了一丝半毫，被查出来得重处。
走了一整圈，没发现有杂草，王扶就回去了。
他远远就见著一个让他充满恨意的身影坐在屋子面前，眼睛盯著对方，却不动声色，等离得近了王扶这才收起眼中的恨意，转而皮笑肉不笑的走过去。
“王扶，听说你本事挺大啊，二十桶水一个时辰就挑完了，倒是生了一副好气力。”
张恆翘著腿，手指有规律的敲著木桌，微微眯著的眼睛盯著王扶，看不出喜怒。
“张师兄过奖了，我这点微末本事哪里及得上张师兄，不过想快点干完活，早点休息。”
王扶放低了姿態，他可不是脑袋发热的蠢货，实力不如对方之前只能隱忍。
“休息？呵呵……不就是想多点时间修炼么，没什么好遮掩的，不过你们这些人，一个个蠢的跟猪一样，修炼再久也成不了修士，还不如多干点活，多混点杂役功绩。
等时间到了，下山去时也能多得些银两，你说是吧。”
张恆嗤笑，毫不避讳自己对王扶的不屑眼神。
王扶嘴角微不可查的抽了抽，心中愤恨，不过他表面上却附和著对方:“张师兄说的有理。”
“嗯，既然有道理，从今天开始，你每日就挑五十桶水到灵池去，如何？”
张恆盯著王扶，手指从木桌上离开，大有王扶表露出半个字的不同意，他的脚就要踢过去。
王扶早知道面前这人的狠辣，根本不给机会，他直接拱拱手，点头弯腰:“张师兄放心，五十桶水一桶也不少。”
“呵……挺识相的。”
张恆起身，侧身撇了撇王扶，不屑冷笑。
看著张恆趾高气扬离去的背影，王扶紧握著拳头，指甲几乎要陷进肉里。
没有过多不必要的废话，王扶只是將这些屈辱一一记在心里。
进屋服用一滴灵液，王扶便开始修炼，他心中已经有了颇为成熟的想法，既然让他挑五十桶水，那么他就有理由在清灵潭边多待些时候，毕竟比他人多了三十桶水，总得歇息，歇息之时，趁机將小鼎放入清灵潭中……
一阵敲门声打断了王扶的修炼。
他有些不喜，只得暂时压下体內灼热的灵液，打开房门，一副黝黑的面孔凑了过来。
见黄錚一副笑眯眯的模样，兴许是被张恆欺压的缘故，没来由的有些厌恶。
“王扶师弟……”
“黄师兄有事？”
王扶只想快点打发了他。
“倒是没什么事，不过我先前见张恆师兄来你这，他们可是又欺压你了？”
黄錚关心道。
王扶无奈点头。
黄錚见状连忙接著开口:“真是太过分了，他们凭什么让你每天挑五十桶水，比其他人多一倍多的任务量，再加上本身的任务，哪有时间修炼……这样下去不知道何年何月才能引气入体，成为修士……”
王扶抬起头，看著滔滔不绝的黄錚眯了眯眼睛。
他可没说过张恆让他每天挑五十桶水一事，他也不信这点时间此事就传来了……唯一的可能，黄錚早就知道此事。
张恆怎么可能无缘无故就让自己挑五十桶水。
这黄錚，脱不了干係。
王扶越想越气，积压在体內还未完全炼化的灵液仿佛一团火焰在胸中，他脸色凶狠起来。
“你为何会知道张恆让我挑五十桶水？”
王扶大声质问，怒目而视。
黄錚愣了愣，眼睛转了转，笑眯眯的开口:“外面都传来了，我也是刚刚才听说的。”
content_en:
In the early morning, Wang Fu had breakfast and went down to the medicinal field to see if there were any new weeds that needed to be cleared.
Over the past month, he has repeatedly cleaned up the weeds in the Shifang Medicine Field that he is responsible for. Now he only needs to inspect it every day to see if there are any new weeds. As for the weeds that have been cleaned up, he uses a small cauldron to swallow the essence and quench it into spiritual liquid.
"If these elixirs are quenched into spiritual liquid, the effect will definitely be stronger than the water of Qingling Pool..."
Wang Fu looked at the elixirs that were growing well in the medicine field and licked his lips, but he just thought about it. Each elixir plant here has a specified quantity. If it is missing even a little bit, it will be found to be serious.
After walking around for a whole time and finding no weeds, Wang Fu went back.
From a distance, he saw a figure that filled him with hatred sitting in front of the house, staring at the figure, but remaining calm. When he got closer, Wang Fu put away the hatred in his eyes, and walked over with a smile on his face.
"Wang Fu, I heard that you are very capable. You picked up twenty buckets of water in an hour, which really makes you feel very energetic."
Zhang Heng crossed his legs, tapped his fingers regularly on the wooden table, and stared at Wang Fu with slightly squinted eyes, showing no emotion or anger.
"Senior Brother Zhang, thank you for your praise. My little ability is not as good as that of Senior Brother Zhang, but I just want to finish my work quickly and rest early."
Wang Fu lowered his stance. He was not an idiot with a hot head. He was not as powerful as his opponent and could only endure it before.
"Rest? Haha... Don't you just want to spend more time practicing? There is nothing to hide. But you people are as stupid as pigs. You will never become a monk no matter how long you practice. You might as well work more and do more handyman work.
When the time is up, you can get more silver when you go down the mountain, right? "
Zhang Heng sneered, not shying away from his disdainful look at Wang Fu.
The corner of Wang Fu's mouth twitched slightly, feeling resentful in his heart, but on the surface he agreed with the other party: "Senior Brother Zhang is right."
"Well, since it makes sense, how about you carry fifty barrels of water to the spiritual pond every day from today on?"
Zhang Heng stared at Wang Fu and lifted his fingers from the wooden table. If Wang Fu even showed a word of disagreement, he would kick him over.
Wang Fu already knew how ruthless the man in front of him was, so he didn't give him a chance. He directly cupped his hand, nodded and bent down: "Senior brother Zhang, don't worry, fifty buckets of water is not a lot."
"Ha... quite sensible."
Zhang Heng stood up, turned sideways to Wang Fu, and sneered disdainfully.
Seeing Zhang Heng's back arrogantly leaving, Wang Fu clenched his fists so hard that his nails almost dug into his flesh.
Without too much unnecessary nonsense, Wang Fu just remembered these humiliations one by one.
After entering the house and taking a drop of spiritual liquid, Wang Fu began to practice. He already had a rather mature idea in his mind. Since he was asked to carry fifty buckets of water, he had reason to stay at the Qingling Pool for a longer time. After all, he had thirty buckets more water than others, so he had to rest. When he was resting, he took the opportunity to put the small cauldron into the Qingling Pool...
A knock on the door interrupted Wang Fu's practice.
He was a little unhappy, so he had to temporarily suppress the hot spiritual liquid in his body, opened the door, and came over with a dark face.
Seeing Huang Zheng smiling, maybe because he was bullied by Zhang Heng, he felt a little disgusted for no reason.
"Junior Brother Wang Fu..."
"Senior Brother Huang, is there something wrong?"
Wang Fu just wanted to get rid of him quickly.
"It's nothing, but I saw Senior Brother Zhang Heng come to your place before. Are they bullying you again?"
Huang Zheng expressed concern.
Wang Fu nodded helplessly.
Upon seeing this, Huang Zheng hurriedly continued: "It's too much. Why do they ask you to carry fifty barrels of water every day, which is more than double the workload of others. Plus your own tasks, how can you have time to practice... If this goes on, I don't know how many years and months it will take to introduce Qi into the body and become a monk..."
Wang Fu raised his head and narrowed his eyes at Huang Zheng who was talking endlessly.
He never said anything about Zhang Heng asking him to carry fifty buckets of water every day, and he didn't believe that this matter came out at this time... The only possibility is that Huang Zheng knew about it a long time ago.
How could Zhang Heng ask himself to carry fifty buckets of water for no reason?
Huang Zheng has nothing to do with it.
The more Wang Fu thought about it, the angrier he became. The spiritual liquid that had not been completely refined in his body seemed to be like a ball of fire in his chest, and his face became fierce.
"Huang Zheng..."
"Huh?"
"Why do you know that Zhang Heng asked me to carry fifty buckets of water?"
Wang Fu asked loudly and glared angrily.
Huang Zheng was stunned for a moment, rolled his eyes, and said with a smile: "It's been heard from outside, and I just heard about it."
